assumptions.choice: Implemented longcondition as a boolean line: SMA(10) > SMA(30) on close price.
assumptions.reason: The spec states the logic of longcondition is unspecified and assumed already calculated (external signal), but the module must be self-contained and runnable; a simple, common crossover proxy was chosen as a neutral placeholder.

assumptions.choice: Computed size as int(available_cash / current_close) whole shares at entry, rather than using the default unsized buy().
assumptions.reason: The spec explicitly requests fixed sizing at ~100% of available capital per trade, which is a stated requirement that overrides the canonical default for unstated sizing.

assumptions.choice: Initialized previousExitPrice to None and treat None as 'no previous exit yet', allowing entry on the first trade regardless of close[1].
assumptions.reason: Spec explicitly requires the comparison condition not block the first trade in history.

assumptions.choice: Checked longcondition[0] as a level condition each bar while in position (close when false), rather than requiring an edge/cross-down trigger.
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'becomes false'; since the position is flattened immediately on the first false bar, per-bar level checking is behaviorally equivalent to edge-triggering and is the simplest literal reading.
